levels.surface: الحسين بن ثوير بن أبي فاختة

notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» names no one: bare relation (rule 7); «رَحِمَهُمُ اللَّهُ» and «(ع)» left out
the Imam is named in «جُلُوساً عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ», in the words after the chain: last link, imam_in_text (ruling 2)
Yunus, al-Mufaddal and Abu Salama are present in the scene, not transmitters; Husayn ibn Thuwayr speaks («قَالَ كُنْتُ أَنَا») and is the last named narrator before the Imam
